## About

[Criterium](https://github.com/hugoduncan/criterium) is a Clojure benchmarking tool.

**Source:** [![GitHub repo](https://img.shields.io/badge/github-%23121011.svg?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/hugoduncan/criterium)

**Artifact:** [![Clojars Project](https://img.shields.io/clojars/v/criterium/criterium.svg)](https://clojars.org/criterium/criterium)

**Status:** This describes the alpha 0.5 branch.

## Notebooks

### Getting Started

- [Introduction](./introduction.html) - Benchmarking goals and choosing the right approach
- [Quickstart](./quickstart.html) - Your first benchmark in 5 minutes
- [Repeatability](./repeatability.html) - Understanding and improving run-to-run consistency
- [Warmup](./warmup.html) - JIT optimization and warmup controls
- [Benchmark Problem Detection](./benchmark_problem_detection.html) - Detecting multimodality and autocorrelation issues
- [Non-Parametric Analysis](./non_parametric_analysis.html) - Histogram, KDE, and mode detection
- [Parametric Analysis](./parametric_analysis.html) - Distribution fitting with model selection
- [Tail Analysis](./tail_analysis.html) - Extreme value analysis for worst-case latency
- [Analysis and View Options](./analysis_and_view_options.html) - Configuring analysis steps and output views
- [In-Situ Measurement](./in_situ.html) - Measuring functions during normal execution

### Domain Analysis

- [Domain Complexity Analysis](./domain_complexity_analysis.html) - Analyzing algorithmic complexity with criterium
- [Domain Comparison Analysis](./domain_comparison_analysis.html) - Comparing implementations with criterium
